assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D side-view game building sprite atlas for the existing Rainbow Patrol painted aviation game. Reference image is this project's own winter-city target atlas: use only its painterly detailed Amiga-adventure visual treatment, create original new shapes. Transparent background, 1536x1024 PNG, exactly FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows (384x512 cells), no labels, no text, no terrain or background. Each isolated building centered in its own cell with at least 16px margin, common ground baseline at y=450 in top row and y=962 bottom row. Buildings mostly SIDE ELEVATION with slight doorway depth, warm hand painted realistic materials, crisp detailed contours, no thick black outlines, no cartoon cubes. Top row left to right: 1 large open timber-and-canvas WWI aircraft hangar, clear deep dark wide doorway with wooden trusses, aircraft workshop equipment inside, grass-season; 2 larger snow-covered timber hangar with wide open doorway and icicles; 3 weathered brick arched aircraft hangar in storm-city condition, doorway intact and roof partly repaired, no fire; 4 coastal stone manor with red tiled roof and two storeys. Bottom row left to right: 5 snow-covered long railway depot and warehouse with loading doors, two-story central office; 6 tall storm-city civic building / clock tower with battle-damaged upper masonry, still standing, no smoke; 7 large coastal red-brick industrial workshop with twin chimneys and tall glazed windows; 8 battered mountain stone warehouse and watermill with broken wooden wheel. Make each architecture clearly distinguishable at small game scale. No aircraft, soldiers, flags, extra props beyond the building. Nothing crosses cell boundaries. Preserve natural transparent alpha.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D game environment texture atlas, 1536x1024 opaque PNG. Exactly 3 columns and 2 rows, each tile 512x512, no gaps, borders, writing or labels. Painted detailed adventure-game realism suitable for a side scrolling WWI biplane game. TOP ROW: three horizontally repeating distant water surfaces viewed at a low side angle with almost no perspective. Left coastal blue-green water, warm daytime, delicate narrow white foam ripples. Middle cold winter river blue-grey water with drifting small thin ice fragments and frosty foam, overcast cool light. Right stormy deep slate-blue lake, subdued steel grey wave caps, distant storm light, no boats or buildings. Each entire square is water only, with closely spaced short near-horizontal ripples, subtle brush texture, no horizon or sky, left/right edges naturally tileable. BOTTOM ROW: three horizontally repeating very narrow airstrip ground material textures viewed side-on, entire tiles are close-up ground material, no perspective or buildings: left compacted ochre dirt/gravel with sparse short grass, middle packed pale icy snow with parallel wheel ruts, right dark muddy gravel with small wet stones. Use natural earthy colours and match the painterly material detail of the supplied original project's scenery. No large highlights, dramatic isolated crests, letters, objects, collage separators or gradients to transparency. This is a production texture sheet, not a scene or mockup.
